correctness.rationale: The published Shu–Osher stages in integrating-factor coordinates have time-only forcing F(t)=v(t)v(t)^T with v(t)=exp(−tA)b. The completed updates reduce to trapezoid and Simpson: the distinct composite nodes number m+1 and 2m+1 and all weights are positive. Their weighted outer-product sums have exactly the corresponding sample-span ranks. For any uniform spacing s>0 let D=exp(−sA). Distinct real eigenvalues of A map to distinct positive eigenvalues of D, and the local inverse −log(z)/s can be matched by a Hermite interpolation polynomial on those eigenvalues through the required Jordan orders. Thus A is a polynomial in D, so cyclicity of b for A implies cyclicity for D. The first min(d,N) vectors of the D-Krylov sequence are independent; take s=h and h/2. This also verifies the fixed-step claim independently of the frozen zero-count proof (whose induction keeps the degree bound within each remaining exponent under differentiation). The exact Gramian is positive definite because a zero quadratic form forces a scalar exponential to vanish on a time interval, hence its derivatives annihilate the Kalman basis. In the nilpotent example v(t)=(1,−t,t²/2)^T. The absolute three-node Vandermonde determinant is h³/8 and the product of Simpson weights h³/54, giving h⁹/3456. The scaled 3×3 Hilbert determinant is h⁹/(4·2160)=h⁹/8640; the congruence determinant is one since trace A=0. Trapezoid is rank two in d=3 and the ratio for Simpson is 5/2, for determinant, not ellipsoid volume itself.

value.rationale: Knowing when Cholesky can first succeed in exact arithmetic, and recognizing that matrix convergence need not control relative determinant near a singular start, are useful. But here the thresholds simply count the already known quadrature sampling directions with standard sampled cyclicity, and the quoted determinant bias is a recomputation of an already indexed exact error matrix. No distinct difficult limit, additional quantitative guarantee or new obstruction remains in the frozen scope.
residual_risks: This decision does not diminish the practical importance of rank loss or apply to the assessment of new perturbation or floating-point results.
